Subject:  
India Goes Electric with Maruti Suzuki e VITARA, introductory BaaS price starts at  
₹ 10.99 lakh + Battery EMI @ ₹ 3.99/km* 
Dear Sir(s), 
You are kindly informed that marking a transformative milestone in India’s electric mobility journey, 
Maruti Suzuki India Limited (Maruti Suzuki), today, commences sales for the e VITARA BEV (Battery 
Electric Vehicle).  
Customers can get details related to e VITARA, experience test drives, and book the electric SUV at 
NEXA showrooms or by visiting the NEXA website - https://www.nexaexperience.com/ebook, with an 
initial payment of ₹ 21 000. 
*BaaS price (Battery-as-a-Service) is a dual-loan ﬁnance product which eliminates the upfront battery cost and makes ownership easy and aﬀordable. The ﬁnance
scheme is subject to approval of individual ﬁnance company/bank/NBFC and subject to their terms and conditions. Mentioned ownership plan is for e VITARA
49kWh model. Calculation is done assuming vehicle running of 60km per day, excluding charging cost. Applicable for personal use only. BaaS price is excluding
all Govt. statutory levies like road tax, insurance, TCS and other Govt. levies. 
Yours truly 
For Maruti Suzuki India Limited 
Sanjeev Grover 
Executive Oﬃcer & Company Secretary
